entity: Parmelin family farm and vineyard (Bursins, Vaud)
detail: Master winegrower and farmer who ran the family agricultural and viticultural business; gave up active operation on entering the Federal Council in 2016.
Member of the board of directors of fenaco from 1996, and vice-president from 2009 to 2015. Resigned on his election to the Federal Council.

entity: Etablissement cantonal d'assurance contre l'incendie et les elements naturels (ECA Vaud)
detail: Member of the board of the Vaud cantonal fire and natural-elements insurance institution; ended on his election to the Federal Council.

entity: Federation suisse des producteurs de cereales (FSPC)
detail: Sat on the committee of the Swiss cereal producers' federation, one of several agricultural-federation committees on which he served during his parliamentary career.
